name: NEG SYNC
remarks: Utilizes the negative envelope and sync capabilities of the JP-8 to create a surging sound with a sharp attack. Play long, sustained chords coupled with moving bass lines or lead lines. POLY I (CHORDS) / UNISON (LEAD). BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV-1 A,D, ENV MOD/VCF
note: Synced pulse pair with an inverted, key-followed ENV-1 on a resonant 24 dB filter, so the cutoff dips then surges back; delayed LFO vibrato on VCO-2. [raw: range2_raw_deg=40]

name: NEG PLUCK
remarks: Utilizes the neg envelope capabilities of the JP-8 to produce a bright, sweeping sound with a sharp attack. Play rhythmic chords with different sustain lengths. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II (VCF). LFO: VCO (VCF). SUGGESTED EDITS: EXPERIMENT WITH VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV MOD/VCF, ENV-1 A, D,
note: VCO-1 pulse over VCO-2 sine an octave down, ENV-1 inverted into an open resonant filter and also sweeping the pulse width, for a dipping, plucky chord sound. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-128]

name: CARS SYNC
remarks: Similar to the sound used on 'Let's Go' by the Cars. Play lead lines in unison or solo mode, depending on phrasing requirements. UNISON / SOLO. BENDER: VCO-2 ONLY (MANUAL SYNC SWEEP), (VCO I & II). LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ/RES, ENV-1 A,D,
note: Classic sync lead: VCO-2 pulse alone (mix fully VCO-2) synced to a 16-foot square, ENV-1 decay sweeping VCO-2 pitch for the sync zap, 12 dB filter on ENV-2. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-132, mix_raw_deg=158]

name: HAMMER LEAD
remarks: A sound similar to that used by Jan Hammer for mellower soloing. Choose key mode depending on phrasing requirements. UNISON / SOLO. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: EXPERIMENT WITH WAVEFORMS, VCF FREQ/RES, ENV-1 D, S,
note: Square plus synced, slightly sharp pulse, equal mix, through a closed 24 dB filter opened mostly by ENV-1 (env mod 8.5, key follow 6.5) for a mellow singing lead. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-124]

name: DUKE LEAD
remarks: Similar to that used by George Duke for funky soloing. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II, VCF (MORE VCF BEND DEPTH THAN VCO'S). LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: EXPERIMENT WITH WAVEFORMS, VCF FREQ/RES, ENV-1 D,S,
note: Two pulses an octave apart with ENV-1-driven PWM, low cutoff swept by full ENV-1 env mod for a funky wah-like attack. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-126]

name: HARPSICHORD
remarks: A sound using the JP-8's HPF to achieve a 'thin' quality. Good for classical lines. Good dualed with 31, 32 strings, splits 31/22,85/22. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: HPF FREQ, VCF FREQ, VCO RANGE
note: Saw plus pulse at 8-foot unison with a slight sharp detune, HPF at 5.5 thins it, key-followed ENV-1 decay on the VCF for the pluck. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-39]

name: ECHO PIANO
remarks: Uses envelope mod to produce a slapback echo effect. Play staccato lines and chords. The echo engages when the key is released. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: EXPERIMENT WITH WAVEFORMS, VCO-2 TUNING, ENV-2 D,S,R,
note: Two saws an octave apart; ENV-1 (A0 D0 S10 R0) holds VCO-2 pitch up via env mod 8.5 while the key is down and drops it at release, so the ENV-2 release tail sounds as a shifted echo. [raw: range2_raw_deg=40]

name: MELLOW RHODES
remarks: A sound similar to that of a soft electric piano. Play pianistically, using a DP-2 damper pedal for sustain (Plug into HOLD). Good dualed with 31 strings. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCO I & II SOURCE MIX, (VCO-1 FUNDAMENTAL, VCO-2 HARMONICS), PULSE WIDTH, VCF FREQ, LFO RATE, LFO MOD/VCA
note: VCO-1 pulse fundamental with a quieter VCO-2 sine high up as the tine harmonic, static mid filter (no env mod), ENV-2 decay to low sustain, VCA LFO tremolo at position 2. [raw: range2_raw_deg=108]

name: HONKY TONK
remarks: Similar to an out-of-tune piano. Play pianistically. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: FINE TUNE, WAVEFORMS, VCF FREQ, ENV MOD/VCF, ENV-1 D,S,
note: Two pulses at 8-foot unison, equal mix, low cutoff opened hard by key-followed ENV-1 for a piano-like bright attack; detune is drawn near zero. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-41]

name: XYLO
remarks: A sound using envelope mod to create an attack similar to that of tuned percussion instruments. Play staccato lines and chords. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: EXPERIMENT WITH ENV MOD/VCO, WAVEFORMS, VCF FREQ, ENV MOD/VCF, LFO MOD/VCA, ENV-1 D, ENV-2 D,R,
note: VCO-1 triangle with VCO-2 pulse synced two octaves up and a small ENV-1 pitch kick, 12 dB filter with ENV-1 decay and high key follow for the mallet strike. [raw: range2_raw_deg=135]

name: SITAR
remarks: Uses the negative envelope mod and the HPF of the JP-8 to produce a sound similar to a mix between the plucked and sympathetic strings of a sitar. Play staccato lines and rolled chords (Descending). POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: EXPERIMENT WITH VCF FREQ/RES, ENV-2 D,S,R,
note: VCO-1 pulse only (mix full VCO-1) with inverted ENV-1 sweeping the pulse width, HPF at 7 and a resonant 12 dB filter on ENV-2 for the buzzy jawari tone. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-129, mix_raw_deg=-156]

name: HARP
remarks: A beautiful effect similar to that of a plucked harp. Play arpeggiated lines or rolled chords, or staccato solo lines. A great arpeggio vehicle. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: WAVEFORMS, VCF FREQ, ENV MOD/VCF, ENV-1 D,S,R, ENV-2 D,R, SPLITS 28/85,28/55,28/83
note: Triangle plus mid-width pulse at 8-foot unison, filter fully closed and opened by key-followed ENV-1 (env mod 8.5), ENV-2 decay to zero with long release for the pluck ring. [raw: range2_raw_deg=-36]

name: HI STRINGS
remarks: Designed to recreate the high, silky violin ensemble. Play monophonic or chordal lines. POLY I OR POLY II. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: HPF FREQ, VCF FREQ, VCO RANGE, LFO MOD/FREQ, FINE TUNE
note: Bright string ensemble: VCO-1 saw 4' + VCO-2 pulse 4' detuned (+21 deg), LFO-PWM and LFO vibrato on VCO-1, 12 dB filter with light ENV-2 mod, ENV-2 slow attack/release shapes filter and VCA (ENV-1 all zero); VCO-2 range pointer +45 deg.

name: MELLOW STRINGS
remarks: Good for warm background string parts. Play sustained chords. POLY I OR POLY II. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: HPF FREQ, VCF FREQ, LFO MOD/FREQ, VCO RANGE, FINE TUNE
note: Warm strings: VCO-1 saw 8' + VCO-2 pulse 8' near unison, heavier LFO-PWM and vibrato on VCO-1, 12 dB filter at 7 with no env mod (ENV-2 sets the VCA swell), half key follow; VCO-2 range pointer -36 deg.

name: S/H BRASS
remarks: PATCH 37 "S/H (SAMPLE AND HOLD) BRASS". Similar to that used in 'The Camera Eye' by Rush. Play sustained chords. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO DELAY TIME, LFO RATE, VCO RANGE, FINE TUNE, VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV MOD/VCF, LFO MOD/VCF, ENV-I A,D,
note: Brass pad with a random (S/H) LFO stepping the resonant 24 dB filter after a delay: VCO-1 saw 16' + VCO-2 saw 16' detuned, full ENV-1 brass sweep; VCO-2 range pointer about -125 deg.

name: CHORUS ORGAN
remarks: A sound similar to that of a tone wheel organ processed through a rotary speaker. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, VCO RANGE/FINE TUNE, ENV MOD/VCF
note: Rotary-ish organ: VCO-1 pulse 16' + VCO-2 pulse 16' detuned (+16 deg), delayed LFO vibrato on VCO-2 only and LFO-PWM, high-res 24 dB filter tracking the keys fully, ENV-2 organ gate (D/S 10); VCO-2 range pointer about -124 deg.

name: BELL ORGAN
remarks: A 'light' organ sound similar to that of other polyphonic synths. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: PWM, VCO RANGE, ENV MOD/VCF, ENV-I D,S,
note: Light organ: VCO-1 tri 16' under VCO-2 pulse set between 4' and 2' (pointer +90 deg; 7.5 deg/st gives +18, read as +19 = 2-2/3' organ fifth), manual PW, ENV-1 decay plucks the 24 dB filter, ENV-2 gate, VCA LFO tremolo.

name: COMBO ORGAN
remarks: Designed to recreate popular compact organ effects. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: REMOVE LFO MOD/FREQ, LFO RATE, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, VCF FREQ
note: Compact organ: VCO-1 tri 16' + VCO-2 sine 4', fast LFO vibrato on both, filter closed but opened fully by ENV-2 gate (D/S 10, env mod 10, full key follow); VCO-2 range pointer +40 deg.

name: CHIFF ORGAN
remarks: Designed to recreate a small church organ; the 'chiff' effect simulates the sound of pipes or reeds opening and closing. Works well in dual mode with patch 45, pipe organ. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: PWM, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, VCF FREQ, ENV-I D, S, A
note: Chiff organ: VCO-1 square 8' with VCO-2 pulse synced to it, VCO-2 set between 4' and 2' (pointer +85 deg; read as +19), ENV-1 short decay at full env mod gives the 12 dB filter chiff, ENV-2 swell on the VCA.

name: PIPE ORGAN
remarks: Designed to recreate a larger cathedral organ. Works well in dual mode with patch 44, chiff organ. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, PWM, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM
note: Cathedral organ: VCO-1 pulse 16' + VCO-2 saw 2' (pointer +130 deg) mixed toward VCO-2, slow LFO-PWM, closed 24 dB filter opened by ENV-1 at full mod (slow A, long R), ENV-2 slow-ish swell.

name: ORGAN BASS PEDALS
remarks: Designed to recreate the pedal sound of a tone wheel organ. Use in split mode, lower keyboard with patch 47, organ, in upper keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, VCF FREQ/RES
note: Pedal bass: VCO-1 saw 16' + VCO-2 saw at 8' (pointer -42 deg, just past the 8' mark), dark 24 dB filter with some res, no key follow, ENV-1 and ENV-2 both organ gates (D/S 10).

name: DRAWBAR ORGAN
remarks: A sound similar to that of a tone wheel organ with the lower three drawbars pulled out. Use with patch 46, organ bass pedals, in split mode. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: PWM, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, ENV MOD/VCF
note: Drawbar organ: VCO-1 pulse 16' (manual PW 7) + VCO-2 saw near 12 o'clock (pointer -1.5 deg, about +5; a 5-1/3' drawbar would be +7), resonant 24 dB filter with full key follow, ENV-2 gate.

name: HARMONIC PERCUSSION
remarks: Simulates the percussion effect on tone wheel organs. Use this in dual mode with any percussive organ sound. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, VCF FREQ, ENV-2 D
note: Hammond-style percussion: SOURCE MIX fully to VCO-2 sine set between 4' and 2' (pointer +86 deg; read as +19 = 2-2/3' third harmonic), ENV-2 decay 5.5 with zero sustain on the VCA, 12 dB filter at 7; VCO-1 square 4' muted by the mix.

name: TRAIN CHUG
remarks: Designed to recreate an oncoming locomotive. Effect engages gradually, so play any number of notes in the lower keyboard area and use lower hold to hear the train approach. Designed to be used with patch 52, train horn, with split mode, assigned to the upper keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, PWM RATE, VCO CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCF RES, ENV MOD/VCF
note: VCO-2 noise cross-mods a 16' pulse; LFO (saw, rate 7) chugs the closed VCF and PWM while ENV-2's slow attack opens the filter as the train approaches.

name: TRAIN HORN
remarks: Designed to be used in split mode with patch 51, train chug. To enhance the effect of a moving locomotive, play any interval (perfect fourth works best) to 'blow' the horn, release the keyboard to hear the 'doppler' effect. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: ENV MOD/FREQ, CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, ENV MOD/VCF, VCF FREQ, ENV-I A, D
note: Two saws about a fourth apart with light cross mod; a small ENV-1 pitch mod lifts the pitch on attack and lets it fall on release for the doppler drop.

name: JUNGLE BEASTS
remarks: A sound reminiscent of older modular synths. Play various notes around the keyboard while using the bender to make the beasts 'growl'. Designed to be used with patch 54, birds, in dual mode. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II (BENDER DEPTH MAXIMUM). LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, LFO MOD/FREQ, ENV MOD/FREQ, CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, VCF FREQ/RES, ENV MOD/VCF, ENV-I A, D
note: VCO-2 in LOW FREQ mode (sine, fast) cross-mods a 16' triangle at full depth; fast random LFO and an inverted ENV-1 sweep VCO-2's rate through a closed, fully resonant 24 dB filter.

name: BIRDS
remarks: Another sound reminiscent of a modular synth. Play various notes around the keyboard while using the bender to increase the 'chirping' effect. Designed to be used in dual mode with patch 53, jungle beasts. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II (BENDER DEPTH MAXIMUM). LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, LFO MOD/FREQ, ENV MOD/FREQ, CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, HPF FREQ, VCF FREQ/RES
note: VCO-2 as a fast LOW FREQ saw, its rate wobbled by random LFO, cross-mods a 16' triangle at full depth; HPF fully up and a resonant open VCF leave only the chirps.

name: SOLO VOICE
remarks: Similar to a 'funny' voice Tomita might use. Play single line notes or chordal lines. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO MOD/FREQ, ENV MOD/FREQ, VCF FREQ, ENV-I A,D
note: Two triangle/sine VCOs (4' and 2') through a resonant 12 dB filter; inverted ENV-1 dips both pitch and cutoff for a vocal 'wah', with delayed sine vibrato.

name: CHOIR VOICES
remarks: Designed to recreate a muted background choir. Good for 'spacy' Alan Parsons choir effects. Play sustained chords. POLY I OR II. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. EDITS: VCF FREQ/RES, ENV-I ENV-2 A, R
note: Two LFO-PWM'd pulses an octave up (4' and VCO-2 near 4') with slight vibrato through a mid, resonant 24 dB filter; slow ENV-1 swells the filter and slow ENV-2 the amp.

name: GONG
remarks: Uses the JP-8's superb modulation capabilities to produce the complex sound of a gong. Play single notes in the lower keyboard area. UNISON MODE. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCO RANGE/WAVEFORM, VCF FREQ/RES, ENV MOD/VCF, ENV-I D,S,R
note: An 8' pulse cross-modulated by a sine a few semitones above gives inharmonic metal; ENV-1 (inverted) drives full PWM and the filter, ENV-2 rings out with long release.

name: STARTING UP
remarks: Reminiscent of a squadron of prop planes or a locomotive getting into gear. Hold down various notes on the keyboard to "start up"; release the keys to wind down. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO MOD: VCO, VCF. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO MOD, FREQ MOD, ENV MOD, FREQ MOD, PWM, CROSS MOD
note: VCO-2 as a LOW FREQ sine cross-mods a 16' saw; slow ENV-1 (A9, R8.5) raises VCO-2's rate and opens a 12 dB filter so the engine spins up while held and winds down on release.

name: POLY RHYTHMS
remarks: Uses heavy modulation to produce a very rhythmic effect. Play various notes on the keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: VCO- I & II. LFO: VCO, VCF. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, LFO DELAY TIME, LFO WAVEFORM, LFO MOD/FREQ, CROSS MOD, VCO-I RANGE, VCO WAVEFORM, VCF FREQ, VCF RES
note: VCO-2 as a LOW FREQ pulse fully cross-mods a 16' LFO-PWM'd pulse, while the saw LFO also moves VCO-2's rate and sweeps a resonant 12 dB filter at full depth.

name: KLINGONS
remarks: Uses the JP-8's flexible modulation capabilities to produce a sound straight out of a Star Trek episode. Play various notes on the keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: VCO- I & II. LFO: VCO, VCF. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, LFO DELAY TIME, LFO WAVEFORM, LFO MOD/FREQ, ENV MOD/FREQ, FREQ MOD ROUTING, CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCO-I RANGE/ WAVEFORM
note: A 16' triangle fully cross-modulated by a pulse VCO-2; saw LFO and inverted ENV-1 bend VCO-1's pitch while ENV-1 sweeps a resonant 12 dB filter.

name: MUSIC OF THE SPHERES
remarks: Uses the JP-8's cross mod and LFO capabilities to create a rhythmic, poly-tonal effect. Play various chords on the keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II, VCF. LFO: VCO, VCF. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, LFO MOD/FREQ, PWM, CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCO/VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV MOD/VCF
note: Random (S/H) LFO at full depth steps VCO-1's 16' saw to new pitches while a slow LOW FREQ pulse VCO-2 adds light cross mod; ENV-2 gives a plain sustained organ shape.

name: ECHO
remarks: Uses envelope modulation and cross modulation to produce a sound similar to that of a tape echo effect. Play various staccato notes around the keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO,VCF. SUGGESTED EDITS: ENV MOD/FREQ, CROSS MOD/VCO-I, VCO/VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV MOD/VCF
note: VCO-2 as a slow LOW FREQ pulse fully cross-mods a 16' saw; an inverted ENV-1 gate sweeps VCO-2's rate, and ENV-2's decay/release make the repeats fade like tape echo.

name: SOLAR WINDS
remarks: One of many wind-type effects made possible by the JP-8's two noise sources. Play various notes or chords on the keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: VCF. LFO: VCF. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV-I ADSR
note: Mix fully on VCO-2 noise through a highly resonant, key-tracked 12 dB filter; an inverted ENV-1 sweeps the resonant peak for whistling wind.

name: RHYTHM & SYNC
remarks: A rhythmic effect produced by the JP-8's S/H and sync functions. Play various notes and chords around the keyboard. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO, VCF. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, LFO DELAY TIME, LFO MOD/FREQ, VCO WAVEFORM, VCO MIX, VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV-I A,S,R, ENV-I POLARITY, ENV-2 ADSR
note: VCO-2 saw synced to a 16' VCO-1 and heard alone; delayed random (S/H) LFO at full depth steps VCO-2's pitch for stepping sync timbres, with an inverted ENV-1 on the open filter.

name: HANDCLAPS
remarks: Useful for applause or handclap effects. Play quickly rolled note clusters in the upper keyboard area. Use Poly I for applause. Use Unison mode with two or three note clusters simultaneously for handclap effect. Upper keyboard area produces the best results. POLY I OR UNISON. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV-2 D
note: VCO-2 noise fully cross-modulates a 16' triangle (heard alone) into a noisy burst; a fast ENV-1 snaps the closed 12 dB filter fully open and ENV-2 is a short percussive decay.

name: FUZZY FIFTHS
remarks: * TUNE UP A FIFTH (at VCO-2 RANGE). A tuned interval patch useful for warm background 'pads'. POLY I OR II. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, VCF RES
note: Warm fifths pad: 8' pulse VCO-1 with LFO PWM against a saw VCO-2 a fifth up, 24 dB filter half open with full ENV-2 sweep and full key follow; VCO-2 range pointer at +4 deg (~+6 st), set +7 per the sheet's note.

name: UP FOURTH
remarks: * TUNE UP A FOURTH (at VCO-2 RANGE). A tuned interval patch designed to be used in DUAL mode with patch 74, down fourth, to create a 'chord stack' effect. POLY I OR UNISON. BENDER: VCO, VCF. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, VCF RES
note: Fourths stack: 16' pulse VCO-1 (LFO PWM) plus pulse VCO-2 a fourth above it, 12 dB filter low with full ENV-1 sweep and full key follow; VCO-2 pointer at -99 deg (~-8 st), set -7 (16' + fourth) per the note.

name: DOWN FOURTH
remarks: * TUNE DOWN A FOURTH (at VCO-2 RANGE). Designed to be used with patch 73, up fourth. POLY I OR UNISON
note: Partner of 73: 8' pulse VCO-1 (LFO PWM) plus pulse VCO-2 a fourth below, 12 dB filter low with full ENV-1 sweep and key follow; VCO-2 pointer at -81 deg (~-6 st), set -5 per the note.

name: HORN FIFTH
remarks: * TUNE UP A FIFTH (at VCO-2 RANGE). A tuned interval patch designed to be used in dual mode with patch 76, horn tritone, to produce a 'chord stack' effect. POLY I OR UNISON. BENDER: VCF. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV-I A,
note: Brassy fifths: two saws (8' and a fifth up, pointer +9 deg = +7 st), 24 dB filter at 5 with no key follow, full ENV-2 brass swell (A 2.5, S 7.5) on the filter; ENV-1 unused.

name: HORN TRITONE
remarks: * TUNE TO A FLATTED SEVENTH (at VCO-2 RANGE). Uses Env-I sustain to modulate the pitch of the VCO to a tuned interval. Designed to be used with patch 75, horn fifth. POLY I OR UNISON
note: Brass tritone: saw VCO-2 a flat seventh up (pointer +25 deg = +10 st) against saw VCO-1 lifted by full ENV-1 pitch mod (S 2, R 5.5) to the tritone; 24 dB filter swells on ENV-2 as in 75.

name: MELLOW BLIP
remarks: A patch using env mod of the VCO to produce a warm pitch slide effect. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, VCF RES, ENV-I D, ENV-I POLARITY
note: Warm pitch-slide pluck: two 8' saws, inverted ENV-1 (D 4.5, S 0) bends VCO-2 up into pitch at 1.5, 24 dB filter low at 2 with ENV-2 sweep 7 and full key follow; VCO-2 range pointer at -43 deg (read as 8').

name: HARD BLIP
remarks: The 'Toto' lead sound. Uses env mod to produce a punchy synth brass sound. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: ENV-I D, ENV-I POLARITY
note: Toto brass blip: two 16' saws (VCO-2 pointer -134 deg, past 16'), ENV-1 (D 3, R 4.5) kicks VCO-1 pitch at 3.5 for the blip, 24 dB filter at 3.5 with ENV-2 sweep 7 (A 2, S ~10) and half key follow.

name: CLARINET
remarks: A clarinet effect suitable for solo or ensemble applications. POLY I OR SOLO. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: VCO. SUGGESTED EDITS: LFO RATE, LFO DELAY TIME, VCF FREQ, VCO RANGE/FREQ
note: Clarinet: SOURCE MIX turned fully to VCO-2 (pointer past 10), an 8' pulse at PWM 0 (square); 24 dB filter at 3 opened by ENV-1 (A 1, D 3, S 3.5) at 7 with key follow 4 and a little LFO; ENV-2 organ-like VCA. VCO-1 (16' square) is silent.

name: WHISTLE
remarks: Can be used for whistle, piccolo, and flute applications. POLY I OR SOLO. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCO RANGE/FREQ, VCF FREQ
note: Whistle: SOURCE MIX fully to VCO-1 (pointer past 0), a 2' triangle with delayed LFO vibrato (2); filter closed at 0 and opened by ENV-1 (S 10) at 8, level 10. VCO-2 is set to 16' noise but is mixed out.

name: VIOLIN
remarks: A string patch with a pronounced bowing effect. Useful with up and down bends of the bender to produce slurring and gliss effects, i.e. 'fiddle" type sounds. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCO RANGE/FREQ, VCF FREQ
note: Bowed violin: 8' saw plus 8' pulse detuned sharp (fine +27 deg) with LFO PWM 3.5 and LFO vibrato 1.5 on VCO-2; 12 dB filter at 7 with key follow 3.5, ENV-1 (A 5) bowing swell at 2, slow ENV-2 (A 5); both env key follows on.

name: CHIME
remarks: One of the many types of metallic sounds produced by using the JP-8's cross modulation. POLY I. BENDER: N/A. LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ, ENV-2 R
note: Metallic chime: cross mod 4.5 from a 4' saw VCO-2 into a 4' triangle VCO-1, mix a little toward VCO-2; 24 dB filter closed with res 5, full ENV-1 sweep (D 3.5, S 7, R 8.5) and full key follow; long ENV-2 release.

name: HARMONICA
remarks: Suitable for solo or chord applications. Use up and down bends with the bender and appropriate phrasing to simulate the 'blues harp' sound. Play major triads and sevenths for chord type harmonica effects. POLY I. BENDER: VCO I & II, VCF (USE MORE VCF BEND THAN VCO). LFO: N/A. SUGGESTED EDITS: VCF FREQ
note: Blues harp: VCO-2 saw at 4' synced to a square VCO-1, with ENV-1 (A 3.5, D 5, S 5) sweeping VCO-2 pitch at 2.5 for a sync reed bite; 12 dB filter at 5, res 3, HPF 2.5, full key follow; env key follows on. Left third of the sheet is washed out.
